title: Stillwater

services.name: Harvest Fest (& Pumpkin Patch)
services.desc: Join us for Harvest Fest at The Ground at Tabula Rasa Farms, a full day of pumpkins, farm-fresh food, local pours, live music, dancing and good old-fashioned fall fun on the farm. Wander the pumpkin patch. Catch a tractor ride. Grab something delicious from the kitchen. Sip something local. Let the kids get a little dirty. Dance in the barn. Shop the farm stand. Stay awhile. Head out to the patch, wander the farm and find the pumpkin that’s coming home with you. Dive into the filbert play pits, get your face painted, bounce around, visit the farm animals and let the kids run, explore and get a little dirty. This is farm fun the way it should

blurb: Located in downtown McMinnville, this historic event space hosts dinners, group receptions, and private events.Offering a spacious interior and lush outdoor spaces framed with towering lunette windows and warm brick, Stillwater provides a beautiful backdrop to any event.
